name: Endress+Hauser Proline Promag 100 Modbus RS485
notes: Source is E+H Special Documentation SD01148D 'Proline Promag 100 - Register information Modbus RS485', valid for firmware 01.00.zz, parsed from the PDF text layer. Addressing: the document states register addresses follow the Modbus Application Protocol Specification V1.1 (protocol, 0-based), with an optional Modicon 3xxxx/4xxxx prefix for some systems (example mass flow = 2007, or 32007 in the Modicon model), so address_base=0 and the numbers are used unchanged. Read access is FC03, 04 or 23, write FC06, 16 or 23; data types are Float (4 bytes, 2 registers), Integer (2 bytes) and String (strings are not modelled). BYTE ORDER TRAP: float point values depend on 'Byte order' (4915). The factory default is 1-0-3-2 (bytes swapped inside each word) which this preset cannot express; the preset assumes 0-1-2-3 (word_order=big) and exposes register 4915 as rw so you can set it to 0 first. Setting 2 (2-3-0-1) would correspond to word_order=little. Units: flow, totalizer and conductivity values carry no unit in the preset because the unit comes from the unit-code registers (shown as enum points) which are user configurable. The manual warns that each write to a non-volatile parameter is saved to HistoROM, which is limited to 1 million writes - avoid cyclic writes. Communication defaults per the table: RTU, 19200 baud, even parity (1 stop bit implied by 'Even'), bus address default not stated (connection unit=1 is a placeholder). Not included: Heartbeat, simulation (6812-6814), electrode cleaning, sensor adjustment (offset/factor), low flow cut-off values (register/range assignment ambiguous in the text layer), min/max registers, strings (device tag, serial number, firmware version), scan-list registers 5001-5016, diagnostic list. The extraction put several columns out of alignment; parameter-to-enum pairing was done by order within the table and should be re-checked. The document title text in section 1.1 says 'Promass 100' - that is a typo in the source; the cover and register table are for Promag 100.

points.name: Corrected Conductivity
points.note: Float, read only. Unit set by 'Conductivity unit' (2121) (assumed - not stated).

points.name: Totalizer Value 1
points.note: Float, read only. Unit is the unit of totalizer 1 (mass / volume / corrected volume unit register of that totalizer, depending on its assigned process variable). Value is the part below the overflow.

points.name: Totalizer Overflow 1
points.note: Float, read only. Overflow counter of totalizer 1 (documented as a float).

points.name: Totalizer Value 2
points.note: Float, read only. Unit is the unit of totalizer 2 (mass / volume / corrected volume unit register of that totalizer, depending on its assigned process variable). Value is the part below the overflow.

points.name: Totalizer Overflow 2
points.note: Float, read only. Overflow counter of totalizer 2 (documented as a float).

points.name: Totalizer Value 3
points.note: Float, read only. Unit is the unit of totalizer 3 (mass / volume / corrected volume unit register of that totalizer, depending on its assigned process variable). Value is the part below the overflow.

points.name: Totalizer Overflow 3
points.note: Float, read only. Overflow counter of totalizer 3 (documented as a float).

points.name: Volume Flow Unit
points.note: Read/write per manual. Changing a unit changes the engineering unit of the matching measured values; they are not rescaled by this tool.

points.name: Conductivity Unit
points.note: Integer, read/write per manual (default 8). The enumeration text was garbled in the PDF text layer (micro sign missing, repeated names), so no enum is given; read it from the manual.

points.name: Totalizer 1 Assign Variable
points.note: Which process variable totalizer 1 integrates (default Mass flow).

points.name: Totalizer 1 Control
points.note: Control of totalizer 1. 1 = reset and continue, 2/3/4 involve preset or hold. CHANGES / ZEROES THE TOTAL - affects accounting, not the measurement itself.

points.name: Totalizer 2 Assign Variable
points.note: Which process variable totalizer 2 integrates (default Mass flow).

points.name: Totalizer 2 Control
points.note: Control of totalizer 2. 1 = reset and continue, 2/3/4 involve preset or hold. CHANGES / ZEROES THE TOTAL - affects accounting, not the measurement itself.

points.name: Totalizer 3 Assign Variable
points.note: Which process variable totalizer 3 integrates (default Mass flow).

points.name: Totalizer 3 Control
points.note: Control of totalizer 3. 1 = reset and continue, 2/3/4 involve preset or hold. CHANGES / ZEROES THE TOTAL - affects accounting, not the measurement itself.

points.name: Reset All Totalizers
points.note: Write 1 to reset all totalizers. DESTROYS ACCUMULATED TOTALS.

points.name: Flow Damping
points.note: Integer 0..15. The unit (seconds) is not stated in the register table; check the operating instructions.

points.name: Installation Direction
points.note: Changing it flips the sign of the flow reading.

points.name: Measured Value EPD
points.note: Float, read only. Empty-pipe-detection measured value (no unit stated).

points.name: Locking Status
points.note: Bit-coded; value 0 (not locked) is not listed in the document.

points.name: Actual Diagnostics
points.note: Integer code of the current diagnostic event (code table is in the device's operating instructions, not in this register document).

points.name: Byte Order
points.note: Float/integer byte order. FACTORY DEFAULT IS 3 = 1-0-3-2 (bytes swapped inside each register) which this tool cannot decode: write 0 to this register first (preset assumes 0). Register 4915 itself is 16 bit and unaffected.

points.name: Bus Address
points.note: Read/write. Writing it moves the device to a new Modbus address. The default is not stated.

points.name: Baudrate
points.note: Writing it changes the communication speed and drops the connection.
